info.name: Download ZPL label(s) via Booking ID

params.name: zoom
params.description:
Use the "zoom" to get the label(s) sized to your printer needs. If "zoom" is not added to the request, the label response will provide 10x15 cm label(s) in 203dpi.
To receive the 10x15 cm label(s) in other commonly used densities, use these "zoom" values: - 152dpi - zoom=0.85 - 203dpi - zoom=1.00 - 300dpi - zoom=1.20 - 600dpi - zoom=1.70
